body.name: minimax honest expected length
body.construction: \(\mathsf W^*_{n,d,\epsilon,M,\alpha}=\inf_{C_n}\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_{d,\epsilon,M}}E_{Q_P^{(n)}}[|C_n|]\), where the infimum is over measurable random closed intervals \(C_n=C_n(\mathcal D_n)\subseteq[-2M,2M]\) satisfying \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal P_{d,\epsilon,M}}Q_P^{(n)}\{\tau(P)\in C_n\}\ge1-\alpha\).
